features.name: AOTF % per sequence
features.line: AOTF: each laser line's power is set per sequence; in sequential mode each channel has its own lines and %.
features.seenInFiles: 6 of 6 TCS SP8 .lif images (LAS X 3.5.7): 4 sequences, one channel each; 638 nm at 13.5 % in 3 images and 5.5 % in the other 3; the 405 nm sequence also has 552 nm on at 1.5 %.

features.name: PMT gain (V)
features.line: PMT gain is set in volts per sequence; LAS X records it as the detector's Gain.
features.seenInFiles: 6 of 6 TCS SP8 .lif images: every channel on PMT 2, 647-966 V, differing between images of one session.

features.name: Scan speed and zoom
features.line: Scan speed (Hz per line) sets the dwell time; zoom sets the pixel size.
features.seenInFiles: 6 of 6 TCS SP8 .lif images: 400 Hz (0.6 us dwell) in 2, 200 Hz (1.2 us) in 4; zoom 1, 0.85 or 0.75.
